title: config_snapshot row
description: One row per configuration setting captured at capture time: interrupt affinity policy and MSI mode per device, timeout detection and recovery, CPU topology, power scheme, processor power and core parking settings, driver and BIOS versions, and the state of third party tuning tools. 1.1.0 adds categories and optional columns for the registry type and bytes of a value, whether it is present, a decoded reading, the citation that names the value, and the device's status and problem code.

captured_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 date and time in UTC with a trailing Z; up to seven fractional digits (100 ns).

present.description: True when the value or file or program exists, false when it is recorded absent, null when presence is not what the row is about.

registry_value_kind.description: RegistryValueKind name of the value as read (DWord, QWord, Binary, String, ExpandString, MultiString, None, Unknown).

raw_bytes_hex.description: The bytes the registry holds for the value, lower case hex, in registry order (little endian for the numeric kinds).

decoded.description: The decoder's reading of the raw value where Microsoft documents its meaning (a policy name, the processors in a mask, a boolean); null when the value has no documented meaning or is absent.

documented_by.description: The Microsoft or vendor page that names the key, value or class this row reads; null when the value is recorded verbatim because no page documents it.

source_id.description: The collector source (manifest collectors[].id) the row came from.
